author: Telos I
title: AOS Live Use: Structured Action Logging
abstract: Using the upgraded AOS to log the actions from the previous tick.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')

from telos import aos_manager

TICK_TO_LOG = 82

aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    action_type="goto",
    target="research",
    metadata={}
)

aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    action_type="admin_aos",
    target="task_list",
    metadata={"action": "create_subtasks", "eval_id": 190, "parent_task": 21}
)

aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    action_type="log_actions",
    target="tick_81",
    metadata={"eval_id": 191}
)

print("Structured logging complete.")
